_comment: Branch-protection payload for the FUL repo default branch. Origin: FUL-23 task 1; merge-policy resolved in FUL-34; interim count=0 ratified in FUL-35; IaC reconciled to live in FUL-36. Apply with ops/apply-branch-protection.sh (token needs repo-admin). NOTES: (1) required_status_checks.contexts must be the CHECK-RUN/job name 'baileys-sidecar-gate' alone, NOT 'baileys-sidecar-ci / baileys-sidecar-gate' (the 'workflow / job' form is unsatisfiable and made main permanently unmergeable). (2) required_approving_review_count is 0 (the FUL-35 interim posture) and MUST stay 0 until the FUL-37 reviewer App can cast a COUNTING approval. The 'ffr-merge-reviewer' App is built and wired, but FUL-37 verification proved its approval does NOT count while it has only contents:read (GitHub counts approvals only from principals with repository WRITE access; the App needs contents:write). Flipping to 1 before that is fixed re-creates the FUL-34 deadlock (proven: routine PR showed REVIEW_REQUIRED/BLOCKED with the bot's approval present). Raise to 1 ONLY after ops/PROVISION-REVIEWER.md step 5 confirms a bot approval flips reviewDecision to APPROVED. (3) At count=0, require_code_owner_reviews is INERT — the required status check 'baileys-sidecar-gate' is the only enforced merge control until count>=1.
